pr_title: fix: RateLimit verify email and fix
query: Nothing stops a caller from asking us over and over to send the confirmation code that guards a booking, so one address can be buried under them. A code that has already been used is still accepted afterwards. The unauthenticated check and the path that actually creates the booking also disagree about when a code is required at all, and the address is written to our logs in the clear.
